# tomswallapi_tc_filter (Resource)

A traffic-classification filter (packet → class) on a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_tc_filter" "voip" {
  device = "fw1"
  class  = "eth0:10"
  proto  = "udp"
  dport  = ["5060"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `class` (String) interface:class target.
- `device` (String) Owning device.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `dest` (String) Destination to match (zone, interface, or address in shorewall notation).
- `dport` (List of String) Destination ports or port ranges to match.
- `length` (Number) Packet length to match.
- `priority` (Number) Filter priority; lower first.
- `proto` (String) Protocol to match (tcp, udp, icmp, ...).
- `source` (String) Source to match (zone, interface, or address in shorewall notation).
- `sport` (List of String) Source ports or port ranges to match.
- `tos` (String) Type of Service value to match.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_tc_filter.voip 42
```
